items.title_en: French ex-President Sarkozy and wife Carla Bruni to face trial
items.title_zh: 法國前總統薩科齊與妻子卡拉·布魯尼將面臨審判
items.summary_en: Former French President Nicolas Sarkozy will face a new trial. His wife, Carla Bruni, is also involved in this legal case. This follows his jail sentence last year.
items.summary_zh: 法國前總統尼古拉·薩科齊將面臨新的審判。他的妻子卡拉·布魯尼也捲入了這起法律案件。此前，他去年已被判入獄。
items.why_important_en: It shows that even high-level political figures must follow the law.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示即使是高層政治人物也必須遵守法律。

vocab.definition_en: A formal meeting in a court to decide if someone is guilty of a crime.
vocab.sentence_en: The company will face a trial next month.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這家公司下個月將面臨審判。

vocab.definition_en: To include someone or something as a necessary part of an activity.
vocab.sentence_en: Does your new job involve a lot of travel?
vocab.sentence_zh: 你的新工作需要經常出差嗎？

items.title_en: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation
items.title_zh: 美國司法部長迴避有關輝達調查的問題
items.summary_en: The US attorney general did not answer questions about an investigation into Nvidia. Nvidia's stock price dropped by 7%. Lawmakers want to know more about the situation.
items.summary_zh: 美國司法部長沒有回答關於輝達調查的問題。輝達的股價下跌了 7%。立法者希望了解更多關於此情況的資訊。
items.why_important_en: It highlights concerns about government influence on major technology companies.
items.why_important_zh: 這凸顯了人們對政府影響大型科技公司的擔憂。

vocab.definition_en: The act of examining a problem or crime to find the truth.
vocab.sentence_en: The police started an investigation into the accident.
vocab.sentence_zh: 警方對這起事故展開了調查。

vocab.definition_en: To ask for something in a very firm way.
vocab.sentence_en: Customers demand better service from the airline.
vocab.sentence_zh: 顧客要求航空公司提供更好的服務。

items.title_en: More than 300 Russians killed as Moscow props up Mali’s junta, leaked data reveals
items.title_zh: 洩漏數據顯示，莫斯科支持馬利軍政府，超過 300 名俄羅斯人喪生
items.summary_en: Leaked documents show that over 300 Russians died in Mali. They were helping the local military government. The fighting was very intense.
items.summary_zh: 洩漏的文件顯示，超過 300 名俄羅斯人在馬利死亡。他們當時正在協助當地的軍事政府。戰鬥非常激烈。
items.why_important_en: It reveals the hidden cost of Russia's military involvement in Africa.
items.why_important_zh: 這揭示了俄羅斯在非洲軍事介入的隱藏代價。

vocab.definition_en: To show or make known something that was secret.
vocab.sentence_en: The report will reveal the company's annual profit.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這份報告將揭露公司的年度利潤。

vocab.definition_en: Far away from cities or other people.
vocab.sentence_en: We stayed in a remote village during our vacation.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們度假時住在一個偏遠的村莊。

items.title_en: How tariffs, fuel and fertilizer costs are squeezing the U.S.'s biggest apple region
items.title_zh: 關稅、燃料和肥料成本如何擠壓美國最大的蘋果產區
items.summary_en: Farmers in Washington are struggling with high costs. Tariffs and expensive fuel make it hard to sell apples. A strong dollar also makes it difficult to export.
items.summary_zh: 華盛頓州的農民正為高成本所苦。關稅和昂貴的燃料讓蘋果銷售變得困難。強勢美元也使得出口更加困難。
items.why_important_en: It shows how global economic policies affect local food production.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示了全球經濟政策如何影響當地的糧食生產。

vocab.definition_en: The amount of money you need to pay for something.
vocab.sentence_en: The cost of living in this city is very high.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這座城市的生活成本非常高。

vocab.sentence_en: You can purchase your tickets online before you arrive.
vocab.sentence_zh: 你可以在抵達前線上購買票券。

items.title_en: Stocks retreat as AI rebound stumbles, tariff threats loom
items.title_zh: 人工智慧反彈受挫，關稅威脅逼近，股市回落
items.summary_en: Stock prices are going down. The AI market is not growing as fast as before. Also, people are worried about new tariffs.
items.summary_zh: 股價正在下跌。人工智慧市場的成長速度不如以往。此外，人們也擔心新的關稅政策。
items.why_important_en: It reflects investor uncertainty about future trade and technology growth.
items.why_important_zh: 這反映了投資者對未來貿易和科技成長的不確定性。

vocab.definition_en: To move back or go down in value.
vocab.sentence_en: The stock market began to retreat after the news.
vocab.sentence_zh: 消息傳出後，股市開始回落。

vocab.definition_en: A statement or situation that suggests something bad will happen.
vocab.sentence_en: The new law is a threat to small businesses.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這項新法律對小型企業構成威脅。
